findings.lines: e.g. 464-477 (setFlowLimits), and in interchainTransfer / callContractWithInterchainToken / deployTokenManager paths
findings.source: Create3Address._create3Address: keccak256(type(CreateDeploy).creationCode) inside the CREATE2/CREATE3 address derivation of tokenManagerAddress(tokenId)
findings.issue: The keccak of a constant 386-byte creation code is printed with the whole constant (twice per site, 38 lines over 600 characters) instead of as the 32-byte hash it always is.
findings.rule: sha3 of a constant byte string is a constant: fold it at decompile time (and drop the memory copy of the constant when nothing else reads it).

findings.decompiled: mem[160] = 96; s = 160; idx = data.length / while idx - 1: mem[s + 32] = 96; s = s + 32; idx = idx - 1  |  idx = 0; s = 96; t = 0 / while idx < data.length: ... mem[32 * idx + 160] = _30; idx = idx + 1; s = _30; t = delegate.return_code
findings.source: Multicall.sol:22-33 results = new bytes[](data.length); for (...) { (bool success, bytes memory result) = address(this).delegatecall(data[i]); ... results[i] = result; }
findings.issue: The initialisation of results (every element pointing to the empty bytes at 96) is rotated (first element before a count-down loop 'while idx - 1'), and the main loop carries two variables s and t (result and success of the previous iteration) that are never read.
findings.rule: Recognise count-down initialisation loops as one loop over all elements; drop loop-carried variables that are never read.

findings.issue: Testing bit 1 of the roles word is printed as '2 * uint1(x.field_1)'.
findings.rule: 2**k * Mask(1, k, x) >> k is x & 2**k; print the bit test as 'x & 2' (or Mask(1, 1, x)).
